title: ESB PowerLine — Bangladesh Power & Energy Portal
short: Designed and built, with my team at ESB Power Line, a bilingual (English/Bangla) news and data portal for Bangladesh's power & energy sector: daily coverage across 12 sector areas, a live grid-data dashboard and an upcoming monthly magazine.

title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Predicting Mechanical Ventilation Duration
short: Undergraduate thesis supervised by Dr. Swakkhar Shatabda: a multimodal model that combines chest X-rays with clinical data to predict how long a patient will need mechanical ventilation.

title: LoanRisk AI — Loan Default Prediction Platform
short: Full-stack ML web app that scores loan applicants in real time. Model trained on 1.3 million real loan records, served by a Django REST API with a React dashboard showing a risk meter and risk-distribution analytics.

title: QRoll — Smart QR Attendance System
short: Full-stack web app that digitalises classroom attendance: teachers show a time-limited QR code, students scan it with their phone, and reports and low-attendance email alerts are generated automatically.

title: Time-aware Political Sentiment & Narrative Dynamics in Bangla Online Discourse
short: Research on how political sentiment in Bangladeshi online discourse shifts over time: robust sentiment classification, measurable short- and long-term shifts, with a focus on reproducibility, interpretability and ethics.

title: Real-Time Notification System
short: Backend for secure live broadcasting: JWT authentication with role-based access, admin-only broadcasts, WebSocket live dashboard, Redis Pub/Sub message queue and PostgreSQL storage.

title: AI-Driven Data Analysis of Post-COVID Implications on Cancer Patients
short: ML/DL pipelines for cancer classification using medical imaging and clinical data with explainable AI.

title: Joint Segmentation and Classification of Brain Tumors
short: Deep learning system for brain tumor MRI segmentation and classification using U-Net and Attention U-Net.

title: MiniVSFS - A C based VSFS Image Generator
short: C programs to create raw disk images and inject files into a MiniVSFS filesystem.

title: MathaNoshto Compiler
short: A custom compiler in C, covering lexical analysis, parsing, and code generation.

title: Travel Booking Website — Bus Lagbe?
short: A responsive travel booking platform with secure payments using Django, Bootstrap, and DB (MySQL/MongoDB).

title: Catch the Diamonds! — 2D OpenGL Game
short: Interactive 2D OpenGL game using GL_POINTS and midpoint algorithms with real-time collision and scoring.

title: Compatible Blind Stick
short: Low-cost blind stick sensors to detect obstacles and assist safe navigation.
